verdicts.title: Extending holomorphic forms from the regular locus of a complex space to a resolution of singularities
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We investigate under what conditions holomorphic forms defined on the regular locus of a reduced complex space extend to holomorphic (or logarithmic) forms on a resolution of singularities. We give a simple necessary and sufficient condition for this, whose proof relies on the Decomposition Theorem and Saito’s theory of mixed Hodge modules.
